title: docs: clarify secret keys and realtime authentication
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Updated authentication and API documentation to use the dashboard’s Secret key (`sk_`) and App key (`pk_`) names. The docs now distinguish personal secret keys, which should stay out of browser code, from user-authorized secret keys obtained through Connect User Wallets, and explain that secret keys can have configurable model permissions, account permissions, and budgets. Realtime WebSocket guidance now tells browser clients to pass a user-authorized `sk_` key in `?key=` rather than a legacy raw `pk_` key; server clients use bearer authentication. The realtime docs also remove an unsupported WebRTC comparison while retaining the browser-audio guidance for avoiding echo.
